{{Top|leg}}
'''Class A Security Risk''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] classification that included research [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], weapons manufacturers and other individuals in receipt of priority or strategic information. In the event they were ever moved from a secure location, they were upgraded to classification [[Class A Code Red]]. During transfers, these individuals were unknowingly injected with [[Poison/Legends|poisons]] to ensure that, if captured, they would be of no use to the enemy. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctors]] available during the transfer would keep the poison from becoming lethal by administering regular doses of the [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]].<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Desperate Measures}}</ref>
